english.note: For toilets or lavatories, this is the everyday all-purpose choice and is more polite than a blunt term.
Use this polite euphemism when referring to the toilet as a restroom.
Use this softer term when you mean the bathroom or washroom as a room rather than the fixture.
Use this polite term mainly for a public or other restroom when you want to avoid saying 廁所.
Use 洗手間 as a more polite or euphemistic term for the toilet room.
